claims.claim: Retained serial capacity is nonnegative for nonnegative capacity and retention factors.
With factors in [0,1], retained capacity is no greater than the first-stage output or raw capacity.
Total loss decomposes exactly into first-stage loss plus second-stage loss applied to the surviving flow.
Final multiplicative retention and total loss are invariant under stage reversal, although stage attribution can differ.
Full and partial exact witnesses are inhabited.
The exact-rational package regression passes its captured checks.
Capacity units, fixed sequential factors, and their [0,1] range are supplied assumptions.
Any real oversight protocol, model alignment, independence, calibration, adoption, delivery, payment, or revenue is established.
